brief:
Palestinians in Gaza City held a mass funeral on Sunday for 75 people whose bodies were recovered from rubble, Middle East Eye reported. The funeral brought together residents to mourn relatives killed in the ongoing conflict.

The bodies were pulled from collapsed structures across Gaza, where widespread destruction has left many dead and missing beneath buildings damaged in the fighting.
dek: Watch: Palestinians hold mass funeral for killed loved ones in Gaza Palestinians in Gaza City held a mass funeral for 75 people whose bodies were recovered from the rubble on Sunday.
title: Gaza Palestinians bury 75 recovered from rubble in mass funeral
